headline: Lombardy Is Europe's Third Regional Economy: GDP of 505 Billion, Only Île-de-France and London Are Worth More
summary: Lombardy's GDP of 505 billion makes it Europe's third-largest regional economy, behind only Île-de-France and London. Manufacturing and SMEs are strengths, while taxation, energy costs and skilled labor shortages weigh on it.
why: Lombardy, centred on Milan, is Italy's largest regional economy and a major manufacturing hub. Its cost base and labor market affect Italian industrial output and corporate profitability.
